linework.observation: Bold clean contours define both characters, their hands, the envelope and submarine-pier details.

colour.observation: Muted navy, cream and warm sunset colors remain balanced and natural.

shading.observation: Cel-shaded faces and coveralls with simplified illustrated harbor surfaces.

character_construction.observation: Protagonist has bald rounded head and full face; Mara has a normal face and brown hair.

backgrounds.observation: Harbor pier, moored submarine and dock structures form a clear outdoor setting.

finish.observation: Crisp 2D illustration with clear expressions and no visible artifacts.

identity.observation: The protagonist remains bald; Mara has hair and is visually distinct.

content.observation: A family letter handoff at the pier fits the separation-from-home cost beat.

composition.observation: Two-shot keeps both full figures and their envelope visible with clear margins.

regions.people_faces: Bald protagonist looks down at the letter; brown-haired Mara faces him with a soft, worried expression.
regions.clothing: Protagonist in navy coveralls; Mara in dark practical clothes with hair tied back.
regions.architecture: Submarine moored beside the pier, with dock infrastructure behind.
regions.distance: Waterfront and submarine add scale without obscuring either person.
regions.lighting: Warm late-day light, gentle contrast and muted sky.
